verdict.rationale: Anytype has no native built-in AI assistant; instead it exposes a local API and official MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) can read/search/modify Objects 'through conversation,' effectively enabling Q&A, summarization, and drafting grounded in the user's notes, with the assistant limited to explicit API/Agent-skill access to Channels. missing for 10: a first-party in-app assistant UI, explicit fine-grained data-scoping controls (which channels/objects are visible), and independent hands-on evidence of these AI workflows actually working well.
